title: chore(versions): add `--fix` flag to auto-fix version mismatches
body:
**Summary**

This PR implements a `--fix` flag in `tests/versions/index.js` so `yarn test:versions --fix` auto-fixes instead of failing.

- Extract shared constants (`PACKAGE_GROUPS`, `VERSION_FILES`, `buildVersionFileContent`) into `tests/versions/shared.js`
- Add `tests/versions/fix-mismatches.js` which programmatically fixes version mismatches by bumping lagging packages to the highest group version, updating version files, and inserting CHANGELOG entries

The process is still manual for now, we can switch to auto-fix in CI after a bit.
